moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty, helped off practice, is believed to have sprained his ankle; not considered long‑term, team breathing a sigh of relief.
moments.why: Massive fantasy football buzz and NFL roster stakes make this injury news immediately viral among men 25‑45.

moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Sources: The #Browns are naming Deshaun Watson as their starting QB for Week 1.
moments.why: QB controversies drive huge NFL draft/fan chatter—the starter decision sparks tons of engagement.

moments.author: TNA Wrestling
moments.quote: Avery Styles announces that he has signed with TNA! #TNALockdown
moments.why: Pro‑wrestling fans are hyped by the son of AJ Styles officially debuting and signing—big cultural moment.

moments.author: Marjorie Taylor Greene
moments.quote: Now Trump is going to buy 300,000 metric tons of ground beef apparently from Argentina undercutting the American cattlemen.
moments.why: Striking political outrage mixed with absurd economic claim catches fire in culture and news circles.
